analysis: Both units are base-side excerpts of docs/architecture/inference.md (lines 2863-3240 and 3241-3640), a documentation-only change. The patch excerpt is truncated, but its visible hunks only add prose on served-speed records (serving scope, tensorAssistant split), a tp-check --layer-stride flag, and similar documentation. Nothing in the supplied evidence changes executable code, keys, attestation, authorization, encryption, cache storage, or wire contracts. The base text restates controls that already exist: MiMo native load ownership and memory admission, media decode accounting, coordinator-serving encryption in ProviderLoop+InferenceHandler, cluster member registration with equal-share tensor-parallel checks, and installed-owner launches that accept no peer-supplied environment. None of these is shown to be modified. T-041's prefix-cache posture, including the 30-minute TTL, HMAC lookup names, and SEC-035, is unchanged by the visible excerpt. The documented pair-speed record split only affects routing and planning documentation, not trust boundaries; no claim of new qualification or production activation is made. Residual uncertainty: the patch excerpt is truncated (hunks at head lines about 6725-7454 are not visible), so I cannot confirm that those later hunks avoid weakening documented security claims, for example by overstating qualification or isolation. The next pass should check them for statements that contradict TB-007, TB-011, or T-041.
